
```{r build-cea-tables, include=FALSE}
# Strategy display labels
strategy_labels <- c(
  "control" = "Standard care (FLOX)",
  "crp" = "CRP-guided",
  "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF-guided",
  "tlr" = "TLR-guided"
)

build_cea_table <- function(result, model_label) {
  base_results <- result$base_results
  icer_obj <- result$icer_obj
  icer_df <- as.data.frame(icer_obj)

  # Calculate LYs (undiscounted life-years from model traces)
  # Use Effect (discounted QALYs) as primary outcome, Cost for costs
  cea_df <- icer_df %>%
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,
      Strategy_Label = strategy_labels[Strategy],
      Cost_fmt = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Cost), big.mark = ",")),
      QALY_fmt = sprintf("%.2f", Effect),
      Inc_Cost = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Cost), "-", sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Inc_Cost), big.mark = ","))),
      Inc_Effect = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Effect), "-", sprintf("%.2f", Inc_Effect)),
      ICER_display = case_when(
        Status %in% c("D", "ED") ~ "Dominated",
        is.na(ICER) & Status == "ND" ~ "Reference",
        !is.na(ICER) ~ sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(ICER), big.mark = ",")),
        TRUE ~ "-"
      ),
      Status_display = case_when(
        Status == "ND" & is.na(ICER) ~ "Reference",
        Status == "ND" ~ "Non-dominated",
        Status == "D" ~ "Dominated",
        Status == "ED" ~ "Ext. dominated",
        TRUE ~ Status
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Model, Strategy_Label, Cost_fmt, QALY_fmt, Inc_Cost, Inc_Effect,
           ICER_display, Status_display)

  return(cea_df)
}

# Build tables for Models A and C
cea_A <- build_cea_table(all_results$Model_A, "Model A (Joint)")
cea_C <- build_cea_table(all_results$Model_C, "Model C (Separate)")

combined_cea <- rbind(cea_A, cea_C)
```

## Model A: Joint Specification

```{r display-model-a}
kable(cea_A %>% select(-Model),
      caption = "Model A (Joint): Full cost-effectiveness results, overall MSS population",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost", "QALYs", "Inc. Cost", "Inc. QALYs",
                     "ICER", "Status"),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 6))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12)
```

## Model C: Separate Specification

```{r display-model-c}
kable(cea_C %>% select(-Model),
      caption = "Model C (Separate): Full cost-effectiveness results, overall MSS population",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost", "QALYs", "Inc. Cost", "Inc. QALYs",
                     "ICER", "Status"),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 6))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year. Norwegian healthcare perspective.",
      "Model A: All three biomarkers as main effects and all treatment-biomarker interactions.",
      "Model C: One biomarker and its treatment interaction per model (separate models for each strategy).",
      "ICER = incremental cost-effectiveness ratio vs. next non-dominated alternative.",
      "Dominated = more costly and less effective than comparator.",
      paste0("WTP threshold: \u20AC", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY.")
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save raw numeric data
save_data <- rbind(
  as.data.frame(all_results$Model_A$icer_obj) %>% mutate(Model = "A"),
  as.data.frame(all_results$Model_C$icer_obj) %>% mutate(Model = "C")
)
write.csv(save_data, file = here("tables", "table_s5.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_s5.csv"), "\n")
```

Table S5 has been saved to `tables/table_s5.csv`.
